description: This file defines the 'DowntimeEntry' class, which is a Frappe framework document used for recording and validating downtime events within a manufacturing process, calculating downtime duration based on provided start and end times.

classes.name: DowntimeEntry
classes.description: A Frappe Document subclass representing a manufacturing downtime entry, including validation logic to calculate downtime duration.

methods.name: validate(self)
methods.description: Validates the downtime entry, calculating the downtime in minutes if both 'from_time' and 'to_time' are provided.
